gizmo.title: Fiidiyow
gizmo.description: Ciyaarista fiidiyowga oo la heli karo oo ka timaadda ilo badan.

advanced.title: Raadadka qoraalka
advanced.description: Qoraal-hoosaadyo, turjumaado, sharaxaado, iyo raadad kale oo qoraal ah oo fiidiyowga ah.

advanced.title: Waqtiga bilowga
advanced.description: Ka bilow fiidiyowga waqti gaar ah (ilbiriqsiyo).

advanced.title: Waqtiga dhammaadka
advanced.description: Ku dhammee fiidiyowga waqti gaar ah (ilbiriqsiyo), waxay u baahan tahay waqti bilow.

advanced.title: Daar habka waxbarashada
advanced.description: Wuxuu damiyaa hor-u-socodsiinta degdegga ah iyo dib-u-celinta.

advanced.title: Ka saar badhanka ka fur YouTube
advanced.description: Wuxuu ka saaraa badhanka fiidiyowga lagu furo YouTube.

advanced.title: Ma ku daraysaa xiriir wadaag?
advanced.description: Wuxuu bixiyaa xiriir lagu wadaago fiidiyowga.

advanced.title: Raadka sharaxaadda codka
advanced.description: URL-ka raadka sharaxaadda codka (fayl MP3 ah) oo sharxaya waxyaabaha muuqda.

developer.title: Crossorigin
developer.description: Wuxuu muujiyaa in la isticmaalayo CORS.

developer.title: Oggolow ciyaarista gadaasha
developer.description: Sii ciyaar marka tab-ka baadhaha uu diiradda lumiyo.

developer.title: Dami Isdhexgalka
developer.description: Dami habka isdhexgalka ee ka dhiga qoraalka mid la gujin karo.
